display_long_description:
Lead a three-person tactical unit through intense standalone VR combat.

Take on multiple missions across varied combat environments. Some operations place you and two AI teammates against armed enemy squads in tactical Search & Kill firefights. Enemies move through the environment, use cover, change positions, and return fire as each battle develops.

Other operations throw your squad into dangerous zombie outbreaks. Push through infected areas, survive relentless attackers, recover critical supplies, complete mission objectives, and reach extraction. Different zombie types can pursue, surround, and ambush the squad, turning every encounter into a close-range fight for survival.

You are not fighting alone. Direct your AI teammates to tactical positions, order door breaches, call them back to guard you, or release them to find and engage nearby threats. Gesture-based squad commands let you control the battlefield while remaining inside the action.

FEATURES

• Multiple tactical missions across varied environments
• Search & Kill gunfights against armed enemy squads
• Zombie operations with pursuit, surrounding, and ambush behavior
• Enemies that move, use cover, and fire back
• Two teammates that move, fight, protect, and follow commands
• Easy, Normal, and Elite difficulty settings
• Guided training for movement, shooting, and squad control
• Mission objectives, results, and extraction sequences
• Eight interface languages
• Single-player gameplay with no login, advertis
